question: Can a calibrated compact local causal change detector avoid false structural repairs due to noisy observations while retaining sensitivity and matching full Bayesian inference at fewer counted hypothesis operations?
predecessor: ENERGY-TRANSFER-17 NO_GO: 4/12 NULL false change declarations; 75% exact shifted-mask recovery. Do not replay seeds.
hypothesis_family: 62 nonzero five-bit XOR masks times two bias bits, known 15% flip noise. Uniform old prior; before NEW, P(CHANGE)=0.25. Under CHANGE, exp(-Hamming(mask,bias distance)) prior over all different new hypotheses, normalized per old hypothesis.
generative_law: 24 OLD observations from unknown XOR mask/bias. NEW 16 action-observation pairs on same deterministic schedule shared by every model: 12 distinct input contexts + 4 repeatable seeded contexts. NULL retains law; SINGLE toggles one mask bit; DOUBLE swaps one active and one inactive mask bit; NONLINEAR adds an unmodeled two-input AND interaction to old XOR.
calibration: Use 120 NULL-only worlds (not used in primary or smoke). Compute local and exact-full and MAP-full posterior P(change). Set each method's threshold at sorted zero-index max(0,min(n-1,ceil(0.97*(n+1))-1)). Alarm iff score strictly exceeds threshold. Freeze this threshold before primary; no retuning.
candidate: Local MAP-anchored no-change versus radius<=2 structural-change hypothesis Bayes factor. Normalize exponential distance change prior over only considered local alternatives; report continuous posterior probability. Preserve OLD posterior and readout.
controls: Full Bayes: marginalize OLD posterior over 62 hypotheses, 62 possible NEW hypotheses, transition prior excluding unchanged hypothesis; calibrated threshold on same NULL cohort.
Full MAP old structure + all 61 NEW changes with normalized transition prior; separately NULL calibrated.
Same full Bayes with fixed P(change)>=0.95 threshold.
Same local model with fixed P(change)>=0.80 threshold.
NEW-only maximum likelihood XOR structure vs OLD MAP without calibrated threshold.
outcomes: Primary NULL false alarms (60); SINGLE+DOUBLE changed detection (120); nonlinear out-of-family detection (60); binary-change event Brier from posterior score on 180 familiar worlds; old JSON same-process exact posterior/readout roundtrip; per-world 24 OLD +16 shared NEW and 12 distinct contexts; likelihood and transition operation counts (not runtime); include seven detection policies and world scores.

success.false_alarm: local calibrated alarms <= 5% on 60 NULL worlds
success.sensitivity: local calibrated >=65% SINGLE+DOUBLE changed world TPR, and no worse than exact full calibrated TPR by >10 percentage points
success.score: local event-Brier <= fully marginalized exact Bayesian event-Brier +0.025 on 180 familiar worlds
success.noise_reduction: local calibrated NULL false alarm <= local fixed 0.80 alarm, and at least 10 percentage points better if fixed 0.80 NULL false alarm >=10%
success.operation_proxy: full exact operation count / local operation count >=2.0 including OLD and NEW inference
success.integrity: all 240 primary worlds 24 OLD/16 NEW, first 12 unique, same action/outcome trace; OLD posterior/readout identical after JSON serialization in same process; calibration and primary disjoint; frozen thresholds without retune.
success.rule: All must pass for DEV_SIGNAL_UNQUALIFIED only. Otherwise SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO. Independent science/native acceptance always unavailable without separate source and owner qualification.

procedure: Commit prereg first, then independent executable, verify exact GitHub blob before smoke. Run one disjoint smoke, 120 NULL calibration, then one 60-seed x4-family primary. Audit without replay, retain negatives. No threshold revision, no seed reuse.
isolation: Only additive source-free synthetic files on existing draft PR #1346. No native training, main, controller, owner runner, scheduled task, paid API, acceptance, checkpoint, model integration, deployment or merge.
